rows.en:
You're safe!?

Geez… You had us worried sick!

You're safe!?

Geez… You had us worried sick!
EATER Test Subject 004…
EATER Test Subject 004… It seems you did not care for my present?
No, quite the opposite! It turned out to be the best Christmas present ever!
What? Surely… you don't mean Atefarina was defeated?
That's exactly what I mean!

Nngh… How can that be?

Atefarina, who also possessed Fusion Steel, should have had the power of immortality… So why?
The answer is [HERO4]!
What…? [HERO4], you say!?

That's right…

To overcome the Vol, you have to awaken to your own self… and gain a strong will!

Wha…

Ha ha ha…!

I cannot stop laughing… Of all the things to say! Overcome the Vol with willpower?

What is this "strong will"? Too much confidence will be your undoing, you know?

Someone like you… might never be able to understand it!

But [HERO4] is alive! The ones who seem half-dead are exactly the ones who hate dying the most!

A fool doesn't think things over and change his ways when someone reasons with him… but when he feels his failure for himself! And by then, it's too late!

EATER Test Subject 004…

Are you calling me a fool? Me, the omnipotent and omniscient… the ruler of the entire universe…

Yeah, that's right!

A foolish ruler goes out of his way to brag about his own flaws… That's exactly what you are! Steel Emperor Zephas!

Then let me ask you…

Are humans not truly foolish, selfish and ugly creatures? The duller a person is, the more they waste their life, the more they long for a life that lasts forever…

If the Vol has a spirit… it is just one thing!

And that is self-love!

A powerful will to love oneself! As long as you are fine, nothing else matters! The weak are devoured and weeded out…

Ku ku ku… Wake up! Face reality!

Living for yourself is also the greatest weapon for protecting yourself! That is the beautiful spirit of the Vol!

…Just how rotten are you?

Then I'll teach you!

The strong will to overcome the Vol… is something no one can steal, something no one can control…

And that is…

That is a heart that loves others!

No matter how you struggle, no matter what dirty tricks you pull… you can't steal people's hearts!

Love is something you keep giving… never expecting anything in return! Giving and giving, even if it means sacrificing yourself, that's what love is!

Only a heart that respects people and loves people can give this Earth true peace! You have no one to love and no one who loves you, so you just can't understand that!
The one… The one who taught me that was Atefarina!

Foolish Test Subject 004…

The greatest flaw of the Vol cells… is that their hosts are finite…

Even if a host gains the Vol's tenacious life force… as long as the host it fuses with is finite, the Vol will eventually die out!

Because… the Vol cells can form fruiting bodies, but they have a reproductive system that cannot bear children!

When the host dies… the Vol shares the same fate!

Test Subject 004… You were the subjects of the final experiment!

That is… to make the Fusion Steel coexist with the Vol cells so they could take on the host's two-sex reproductive system, and breed!
I won't let you do whatever you want!

Heh heh heh… But there is no longer any need!

Just as you say… the result of the final experiment is right there!
What!? What do you mean?
Velvet Reverse is the very child born of Atefarina, who possessed both Fusion Steel and Vol cells!

…!?

Me, a child? A child born from Atefarina?

But at the same time…

I learned that when Fusion Steel and Vol cells fuse, needless emotions dull their aggression…

That is exactly why… both Atefarina and Apfaron fell before you…

And why!?

Because, like you, they were swayed by foolish sentiment!

As you say, affection is a feeling too… But don't forget!

Heartlessness is a feeling too!

But… this EATER is different!

It completely takes over the nuclei of the cells it parasitizes! It is the ultimate combat bioweapon, with no emotions whatsoever!

Learn firsthand how much virtue and strength come from not being swayed by worthless emotions…
No way…!? Satoru…?
Huh…? That's my big brother?
Stop it! Kaori!
It's no use… They've both been completely taken over! Big brother…
The Fusion Steel defeated… and even my lovely EATERs defeated…!?

What's wrong!? Is this all your so-called ultimate combat bioweapon amounts to?

Not being swayed by emotion is a virtue? Don't make me laugh!

In our hearts, there are things we have to protect… the ones we love are alive! We won't be killed by the likes of you!

What's wrong!? Is this all your so-called ultimate combat bioweapon amounts to?

Not being swayed by emotion is a virtue? Don't make me laugh!

In our hearts, there are things we have to protect… the ones we love are alive! We won't be killed by the likes of you!

The power of the armor I wear, the Fusion Steel… fuses with the EATER's Vol cells to become the strongest, omnipotent and omniscient bioweapon…

It won't be like before, you know? Because… I threw away my worthless human emotions long ago!
So this is… Steel Emperor Zephas… your true form!?

Test Subject 004…

The things you fear come upon you more easily than the things you hope for…

There is no escape anywhere, and like insects, you will obey the strong and swear loyalty to them! True peace exists nowhere…
Zephas! You're the one who needs to remember what a human heart is!
If you absolutely refuse to obey, then I will kill you…!
Director! A message from the assault team…

If I destroy this power reactor, it'll all be over…

…!?
Zephas…! You're still alive!?

Naager…

Uuugh… Vol cells that fill this fortress… Devour me… …Devour everything, and grant my final wish!!

Gboh… Ngh… My final wish… Gboh… is… the Earth… burned in crimson flames…!! Gboh… Gboh…

…!?

What a tenacious grip on life! Is this the true form of the Vol cells!?

Carry out your purpose…?

What are you going to do?
The Vol cells have been cultured enough in this Earth's metal core! It's about time they fused with it.
What? Fuse with the Earth!?
What? Fuse with the Earth!?
What on earth are you…?

What on earth are you? From where I stand, you're no more than bacteria! A kind of vermin eating away at the planet…

I have survived by wandering from planet to planet, fusing again and again with planets rich in resources…

Since long before you were born… yes, since a mind-bogglingly ancient time…

If you are vermin, then act like vermin and share the fate of your host, this Earth… Ha ha ha!

Is there nothing we can do…!?

In a situation like this… how do we fight back? And how long will our energy even last…
Who are you…?
Zoffy?
The Earth is beautiful… It is the star of hope for all of you humans! You must not lose it! You must not abandon it!
Thank you, Ultra Brothers…
Even insects have every right to live! I won't let you do as you please!

Nuooooh… Impossible… My… Vol… is… breaking… apart… Gboh… Gboh…

Gboh… Ngh… Zephas… your… final wish… Gboh… …the Earth… burned in crimson flames…!! Fuhahaha… Gboh… Ha ha ha…
The Earth burned in crimson flames…? What could that mean?

…!?

It's going to fuse with the Earth…!
Damn it! What do I do? What do I…
Big brother…
Satoru…? Is it really you, Satoru!?

The fusion of Zephas Core with the Earth can no longer be avoided…

So… I'll fuse with Zephas Core!
Big brother…!
After I fuse with Zephas Core… I'll make this ship self-destruct!
What did you say!?
But then, what about you…?

If I fuse with Zephas Core, I'll be the last EATER! The Vol cells can be wiped out…

[HERO2]… Take care of [HERO4]… I'm counting on you to take care of [HERO4]!
Satoru…!
There's no time! Hurry, go!!
No… Big brother…!!

[HERO4]… You've all overcome the Vol without relying on Fusion Steel!

It was something we could never have done…

But you know… I'm also… here talking with you like this.

It seems that, more than I ever thought… even I had something to protect, someone to love.

And that's you…
Big brotheeer…!!

In this battle, I learned something important from all of you…

That love is the heartbeat of life…

A life without the ability to love others is no better than death… That's what you all taught me, in the end!

Thank you…

Don't worry…

Wherever there's precious love, there's always a miracle…

When the snow outside stops, let's go horseback riding again, okay?
Defeat Apfaron and all the Gigants!
Where are you looking?
Whoa…
Is that all your attacks amount to?
An attack like that won't bring me down!
Ggh…! That one actually hurt a little!

uncertain: U16127-U16175: Velvet Reverse is addressed as [HERO4] and calls Satoru 'big brother'; translated as written
U16116: proverb-like lines rendered fairly literally; 'his' used for the generic fool (愚か者)
U16123: 雌雄異体の生懸系 read as 生殖系 (two-sex reproductive system)
U16132: Vortex calls the enemy 'Kaori' - presumably Kaori has become an EATER; kept
U16174: 芫当 read as 芸当 ('something we could never have done')
U16178: 怖て read as 全て ('all the Gigants')
